howto.text: FOXY CAKES: a cake bakery for the FOX world, built on the Foxy Pies restaurant engine. PUT ME TO WORK for a shift, WATCH THE DEMO for one whole cake, LOOK AROUND to walk the FOX player through the shop, or BAKE YOUR OWN to write any message. Mix: tap the jars. Whisk: circle in the bowl. Pour: pull down to tilt. Bake: PULL IT OUT in the green. Frost: drag while it spins. Pipe: trace the stencil, pick colour + tip, add a border for a bonus. Toppers: tap; sprinkles: drag. In the 3D world it drops into any building through buildCakery() in minigames/cake/cake-shift.js. URL extras: ?walk=1 starts walking, ?demo=1 starts the demo. SOUND: live-synthesized waltz + lullaby and 40 baking sounds (the oven hum rises as it bakes; a bell rings in the green). Help panel (?) has MUSIC, SOUND EFFECTS, VOICE GUIDE and VIBRATION. Merge kit: worlds/meru-cakes.js + FOXY_CAKES_MERGE.md in the export zip.
